value.rationale: The size of the extinction basin is a natural dynamical observable on a minimal family with growing independent cycle rank. The exact two-state transfer, all-length recurrence and sharp exponential probability quantify how free boundaries alter wave extinction relative to periodic boundaries. This is a natural infinite-family classification, not merely an isolated small-instance enumeration.
